entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name or order number to pull up your account?
Thank you, Sam. I see your recent order here. What specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the jersey. It's the wrong size.
Okay, so it's a preference issue with the fit rather than a defect with the item itself, correct?
It's too tight. It doesn't fit. Obviously.

I understand. Let me just check the policy for you... Okay, I see the jersey was delivered 23 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so we can definitely get this sorted out for you. Would you prefer a refund, or would you like to set up an exchange for a different size?
An exchange, I guess. If you have the right one.

We certainly do. And because I see here you're a VIP member with VeloFit, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee and I'm processing the new size with complimentary expedited shipping. You should have it in two business days.
Fine. Whatever. Just make sure it's the right one this time.

Absolutely. I've just processed that exchange. You'll receive an email confirmation shortly with a prepaid return label for the original jersey. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sam?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
